program:
PARAMS = {
    "Win":   (3.0, 1.0, 8.0),    # differential pair width (um), L=0.15
    "Wtail": (4.0, 1.5, 10.0),   # clk tail switch width
    "Wln":   (1.5, 0.6, 4.0),    # latch nfet width
    "Wlp":   (1.5, 0.6, 4.0),    # latch pfet width
    "Wrst":  (0.6, 0.42, 2.0),   # reset pfet width
    "Wbn":   (0.8, 0.42, 3.0),   # output buffer nfet width
    "kbp":   (2.0, 1.0, 3.5),    # output buffer p/n width ratio
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    L = 0.15
    vdd = 1.8
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    Win, Wt, Wln, Wlp, Wr, Wbn = p["Win"], p["Wtail"], p["Wln"], p["Wlp"], p["Wrst"], p["Wbn"]
    Wbp = max(0.42, p["kbp"] * Wbn)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # tail switch
    n.M("MT", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wt, L)
    # differential pair: vinp -> node dp (below X), vinn -> node dn (below Y)
    n.M("M1", "dp", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Win, L)
    n.M("M2", "dn", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Win, L)
    # cross-coupled latch: X above dp, Y above dn
    n.M("M3", "xx", "yy", "dp", "vss", "nfet", Wln, L)
    n.M("M4", "yy", "xx", "dn", "vss", "nfet", Wln, L)
    n.M("M5", "xx", "yy", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wlp, L)
    n.M("M6", "yy", "xx", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wlp, L)
    # reset switches (clk low -> precharge to VDD)
    n.M("MR1", "xx", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("MR2", "yy", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("MR3", "dp", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("MR4", "dn", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    # output buffers: vinp>vinn -> xx falls -> outp rises; both outputs low in reset
    n.M("MBN1", "outp", "xx", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wbn, L)
    n.M("MBP1", "outp", "xx", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wbp, L)
    n.M("MBN2", "outn", "yy", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wbn, L)
    n.M("MBP2", "outn", "yy", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wbp, L)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    cox = 1.0e-15        # ~F per um of gate width at L=0.15
    cj = 0.8e-15         # ~F per um drain junction/overlap
    C_d = cj * (Win + Wln) + cj * Wr
    C_x = cj * (Wln + Wlp + Wr) + cox * (Wln + Wlp) + cox * (Wbn + Wbp)
    C_o = cl + cj * (Wbn + Wbp)
    try:
        ol = lut.op("n", Wln, L, 0.9, 0.9)
        gml = ol["gm"]
        oi = lut.op("n", Win, L, 0.9, 0.3)
        gmi = oi["gm"]
        idi = oi["Id"]
    except Exception:
        gml = 600e-6 * Wln
        gmi = 500e-6 * Win
        idi = 80e-6 * Win
    # phase 1: dp/dn discharge until latch nmos turns on (~Vth)
    t1 = C_d * 0.65 / max(idi, 1e-6)
    # phase 2: regeneration from Av*dv up to VDD/2
    av = max(gmi * 0.65 / max(idi, 1e-6), 1.0)
    tau = C_x / max(gml, 1e-6)
    t2 = tau * math.log(vdd / 2 / max(av * dv, 1e-6))
    # output buffer
    try:
        ob = lut.op("p", Wbp, L, 1.5, 0.9)
        ibp = ob["Id"]
    except Exception:
        ibp = 60e-6 * Wbp
    t3 = C_o * vdd / 2 / max(ibp, 1e-6)
    delay = t1 + t2 + t3
    energy = (2 * C_d + 1.5 * C_x + C_o + cj * Wt) * vdd ** 2 * 1.15  # +15% short-circuit
    return n, {"delay": delay, "energy": energy, "correct": 1}
